async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Catalog' link in the menubar to expand the menu
    await page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name='Catalog', exact=True).click()
    # Wait briefly for the menu to expand
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Now click on the 'Products' link that should appear
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Products', exact=True).click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
